nitroxanalyser.changelog: Adds the DiveStuff Bluetooth app connection with authenticated settings, clock sync and signed phone-to-device firmware transfer. Refines label layout, contrast and previews; keeps numeric examples separate from actual licence restrictions. Moves bounded print history out of settings NVS, preserving exported records and preventing storage exhaustion. Retains calibration, licences and saved settings with update-only installation.

divesoftadapter.changelog: Adds the DiveStuff Bluetooth app connection with authenticated settings, clock sync and signed phone-to-device firmware transfer. Refines label layout and contrast, supports verified perforated media, and defaults new layouts to landscape. Pairing keys remain viewable on the trusted Web UI. Bluetooth-only Wi-Fi shutdown requires a paired app and recorded key; restarting restores Wi-Fi. Existing licences and settings are retained by update-only installation.
